name: botz-mcp-swarm
description: Local-first MCP server testing with the bundled botz MCP Swarm CLI: introspect MCP servers, generate, run and score suites (contract checks, evals, load) on this machine. No MCP server is wired up by default; opt in to Botz platform mode (central https://swarm.botz.ai/mcp) with /z-mcp-swarm-platform.

interface.longDescription: Skills for the botz MCP Swarm CLI that run locally by default: introspect live MCP servers, generate suites from tool schemas, annotations and intents, run contract/schema checks, evals and load tests on this machine, check servers for updates, tag and describe suites, diagnose failures and upgrade saved suites. Platform mode (central Swarm server, remote runs, workers) is opt-in via the mcp-swarm-platform skill.
